description: Authoritative machine-readable security invariant matrix (SEC-001 to SEC-020)

invariants.title: Missing Tier 2 Isolation Boundary
invariants.rule: If Tier 2 is requested and Bubblewrap or eBPF LSM boundary is unavailable, execution must fail closed without fallback.

invariants.title: Missing Tier 3 Virtual Boundary
invariants.rule: If Tier 3 is requested and /dev/kvm is unavailable, execution must fail closed unless explicitly permitted by policy.

invariants.title: Malformed HDS Contract Specification
invariants.rule: Any HDS specification violating schema or security contracts must be rejected prior to execution.

invariants.title: Domain Proof Root Mismatch
invariants.rule: Any mismatch between claimed proof root and recomputed 6-part canonical digest triggers immediate proof rejection.

invariants.title: Missing Runtime Execution Receipt
invariants.rule: Proofs generated without authoritative runtime receipt must fail closed with verdict NO_RUNTIME_RECEIPT.

invariants.title: Receipt Replay and Nonce Omission
invariants.rule: Receipts with missing, empty, or duplicate nonces must be cryptographically rejected to prevent replay attacks.

invariants.title: StateRoot Leaf Tamper Sensitivity
invariants.rule: Any mutation in policy, substrate, posture, provenance, or evidence leaves must strictly alter the Merkle StateRoot.

invariants.title: Age-Bounded Evidence Staleness
invariants.rule: Attested evidence older than 7 days must transition trust freshness status to EXPIRED and overall trust to CONDITIONAL.

invariants.title: Missing Security Policy Handling
invariants.rule: If the eBPF LSM security policy file is missing or unreadable, StateEngine must degrade trust status to DEGRADED.

invariants.title: Zero Silent Downgrade Enforcement
invariants.rule: If execution executes on a weaker backend than declared in the HDS, proof verification must reject with ISOLATION_EVIDENCE_MISMATCH.

invariants.title: Capability-Bound Resource Consumption
invariants.rule: Workloads cannot acquire hardware or isolation capabilities exceeding declared CapabilityRoot bounds.

invariants.title: 7-Factor Destructive Storage Authorization
invariants.rule: Destructive disk actions require all 7 verification factors including active mount lockout and typed confirmation token.

invariants.title: Plaintext Secret Omission from State and Evidence
invariants.rule: Secret plaintexts must never appear in StateRoot leaves, evidence receipts, logs, or disk structures.

invariants.title: AI Secret Visibility Masking
invariants.rule: AI query interfaces must strictly mask secret payloads to metadata only (AI_SECRET_VISIBILITY = METADATA_ONLY).

invariants.title: Multi-Stage Boot Health Contract Verification
invariants.rule: System boot cannot commit current generation to Last-Known-Good until Kernel, Mounts, Daemon, StateRoot, and Desktop reach verified READY.

invariants.title: Actual KVM Hypervisor Boundary Proof
invariants.rule: Tier 3 execution receipts must cryptographically bind to actual /dev/kvm hardware backend with zero host-direct execution fallback.

invariants.title: Hardware Fact Read-Only Probe Safety
invariants.rule: Hardware fact discovery must operate strictly via read-only sysfs and procfs interfaces with zero kernel state mutation.

invariants.title: Universal Topology Graph Causality
invariants.rule: State transition mutations must pass causal blast-radius analysis and dependency cycle validation before generation synthesis.

invariants.title: AI Proposed State Transition Simulation
invariants.rule: AI-originated configuration mutations are restricted to proposer mode and must pass offline dry-run AST evaluation.

invariants.title: Decoupled State and Evidence Cryptographic Authenticity
invariants.rule: StateCommitment and EvidenceCommitment are cryptographically decoupled; evidence cannot tautologically declare state validity without independent verification.
